frames.heading: Zarvox
frames.body: This feeling is... unprecedented. Our bodies move faster, with purpose.

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: You Martians have some smooth moves! Once you caught that rhythm, there was no stopping you!

frames.heading: Zarvox
frames.body: We have evolved our dance. Your funk has altered our rhythm forever.

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: That's the magic of music, Zarvox! It connects us all. I'm just glad I could bring a little Earth funk to Mars.

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: I knew you had it in you! Keep dancing, Mars - there's no limit to the groove!

frames.heading: Zarvox
frames.body: You are welcome here anytime, Mojo. Our rhythm will never be the same.

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: I'll be back someday! But for now, I've got more places to bring the funk. The galaxy's calling!
